EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR COUNCIL

These Executive and Corporate Directors have been hand selected by Melaleuca’s management team to represent Melaleuca’s Marketing Executives. This Group, known as the Executive Director Council & Hispanic Executive Director Council, meet with Melaleuca’s management team frequently to give feedback and their perspectives on many aspects of the Melaleuca business.
